title: CLI Interface
description: Connect-RPC client commands covering the full P0 surface area. Default human-readable output (per feedback_cli_default_human_output); --json available for scripting.

requirements.title: Command tree
requirements.description: Top-level command groups: `goldens` (list, get, register, regenerate), `skills` (sync, list, get), `manifests` (list, get, create, update, delete), `validate` (skill <skill_id> <golden_id>, tool <tool_id> <golden_id>, all <golden_id>), `verdicts` (latest, history), `stale` (list, clear). Stale tuples require --force or --yes on validate commands.

validation.notes: Top-level command groups (goldens, skill-catalog, manifest, validation, record, report, staleness) registered.
CLI manifest coverage guard forces a binding per service RPC (anti-drift).
Full CLI surface exercised live 2026-05-29 (sync, register, manifest upsert, validation start --wait, staleness list, record list).
